judge.rationale: The candidate delivers a clean, fully working implementation that satisfies every acceptance criterion in the issue. It chooses the same single-argument accumulation approach and `totalUsage` parameter name as the reference, and implements an identical `accumulateUsage` function (placed in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` rather than inline in `chatOrchestrator.ts`). To satisfy the criterion that 'the type of what the hook receives makes the answer unambiguous', the candidate also introduces a structurally identical `TurnUsage` interface alongside `totalUsage`, which remains 100% backwards-compatible in TypeScript. The only minor drawbacks compared to the reference are the creation of a separate acceptance test file and committing `.lore/dod.md`.
